edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a protective direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: In rheumatoid arthritis, methotrexate reduces systemic inflammatory tone and disease activity; any cardiovascular benefit is thought to come from lowering inflammation-driven vascular injury rather than from a direct lipid effect.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2023 Gao meta analysis in Heliyon already points to methotrexate tracks with lower risk or better outcomes, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Healthier-user bias, screening intensity, and baseline risk can all inflate apparent benefit in observational work, so the magnitude should be read conservatively.
